category_title: Actively engaged students with severe disabilities in large-group instruction
scenario_title: Physical limitation during whole-group auditory attention check
minimal_context: The student is participating in a whole-group classroom transition activity at their desk.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay class, it is time to transition to our next subject. Let's get ready.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Puts hands up, slaps the desk 2 times and says) Science!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Now, if you can hear me, place your hands on your head.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Remains still at the desk, unable to lift hands to their head due to physical disability.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I am waiting for everyone to do it.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks away and becomes completely disengaged from the activity because it is not possible to participate.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Okay class, it is time to transition to our next subject. Let's get ready.

STUDENT: (Puts hands up, slaps the desk 2 times and says) Science!

TUTOR: Now, if you can hear me, place your hands on your head.

STUDENT: (Remains still at the desk, unable to lift hands to their head due to physical disability.)

TUTOR: I am waiting for everyone to do it.

STUDENT: (Looks away and becomes completely disengaged from the activity because it is not possible to participate.)
